Label.text: You can draw shapes, lines, and curves in the black square at the top. These are then broken down into
frequency ranges based on the Y-axis, while the X-axis represents time. This matrix then creates sound synthesis.
You can draw with the mouse while holding down the left mouse button. Note: An increase in pixels towards 'Y' increases the volume slightly.
